method_note: Meta publishes exact safe-zone percentages/pixels only for paid Reels/Stories/Feed/Carousel ad creative (facebook.com/business/ads-guide). Organic-post, avatar, highlight-cover and Reels-cover-crop numbers are not published by Meta with pixel specs; those entries are 'secondary' or 'derived' and say so.

reels_ads_safe_zone.safe_area_note: top 14% of 2560=358, bottom 35% of 2560=896, sides 6% of 1440=86 each (Meta's own stated percentages, pixel values computed from Meta's stated canvas)

reels_organic_safe_zone_derived.note: Same Meta percentages (14% top, 35% bottom, 6% sides) applied to the common 1080x1920 organic canvas instead of Meta's 1440x2560 ad canvas: top=0.14*1920=268.8->269; bottom=0.35*1920=672; sides=0.06*1080=64.8->65. Safe content box = 1080-2*65=950 wide, 1920-269-672=979 tall.

reels_right_action_column.note: No Meta pixel box published and no consistent pixel box across secondary sources. It falls inside the bottom-35%/right-6% ad safe-zone exclusion already listed above, but multiple design blogs say it visually occupies more width than the 65px minimum margin in practice. Not confirmed as an exact box - see 'unconfirmed' section.

reels_cover_grid_crop_band.note: Grid tile ratio is 3:4 (width/height=0.75). At fixed tile width 1080, tile height = 1080/0.75 = 1440. Cropping the 1920-tall 9:16 cover to 1440 tall, centered: (1920-1440)/2=240 lost from top and bottom each, so visible band is y=240 to y=240+1440=1660.

reels_tab_display.note: Reels tab shows the full 9:16 cover/video uncropped. Widely and consistently reported, not disputed, but not a Meta doc.

stories_ads_safe_zone.note: Meta's current (2026) ads-guide pages state the same 14% top / 35% bottom / 6% sides figure for Stories as for Reels ads.

stories_organic_safe_zone_derived.note: Same arithmetic as reels_organic_safe_zone_derived, applied to Stories.

stories_legacy_safe_zone_disputed.note: Older / some current secondary sources cite Stories bottom margin as 20% (340px of 1920) rather than 35% (672px). Meta's live 2026 ads-guide pages we fetched show 35%, suggesting this 14/20/6 figure is legacy and superseded, but it is still widely used in templates. Flagged as a disagreement, not resolved.

stories_interactive_stickers.note: No Meta-published coordinates. Qualitative guidance only: place polls/quizzes/countdowns/link stickers in the 'middle-lower' band, not at the very bottom edge (the reply-bar overlay makes bottom-edge stickers unclickable).

feed_image_ad_4_5.note: Meta's feed image ad spec page publishes resolution/ratio/tolerance but no visual safe-zone margin - only text character limits (125 primary text, 40 headline).

feed_organic_portrait_4_5.note: Most commonly recommended organic feed size across secondary sources.

feed_organic_landscape_191_1.note: One source gives 1080x608 instead of 1080x566 for the same nominal 1.91:1 ratio - minor rounding disagreement between secondary sources, not resolved.

feed_organic_3_4_no_crop.note: Feature reported as added ~2025-05-30 letting users upload natively at 3:4 with no forced cropping. This exactly matches the 3:4 grid tile ratio, so a 3:4 upload shows with zero crop in the profile grid.

profile_grid_tile_ratio.note: Both canvas examples are the same 3:4 ratio at different base resolutions cited by different sources - not a real disagreement, just different scale references. Change announced by Instagram Head Adam Mosseri, reported 2025-01-19; replaced the prior 1:1 grid tile.

grid_crop_from_1_1.note: 3:4 tile ratio = width/height 0.75. Source height 1080 is the limiting dimension, so crop width = 1080*0.75 = 810. Centered: (1080-810)/2 = 135 lost each side, visible x-band = 135 to 135+810=945. Full 1080 height kept.

grid_crop_from_4_5.note: Crop width = source height * 0.75 = 1350*0.75 = 1012.5 -> ~1013. Centered: (1080-1013)/2 = 33.5 -> ~33/34 lost each side, visible x-band ~33 to 33+1013=1046. Full 1350 height kept. Matches the '1013x1350' figure some secondary sources cite directly.

grid_crop_from_3_4.note: 3:4 source already matches the 3:4 tile ratio exactly - no crop needed. This is the stated reason Meta added the native 3:4 upload option in 2025.

carousel_organic_mixed_ratio_rule.rule: first slide's aspect ratio is applied to the whole carousel; later slides with a different ratio are auto-cropped to match, without an upload error

profile_avatar.note: No Meta doc found. Displayed sizes disagree across secondary sources and likely vary by client/DPI; no confirmed single number. No published safe-circle-inset percentage for the pre-crop square - guidance is qualitative only (keep subject centered).

displayed_diameter_disputed.px: ~700 (described as 'safe crop area', not display size)

highlight_cover.note: Upload canvas (1080x1920, 9:16) is a secondary-source consensus, not a Meta doc. The inscribed-circle safe square (largest circle fitting a 1080-wide x1920-tall rectangle has diameter = width = 1080, centered vertically: (1920-1080)/2=420 to 420+1080=1500) is derivable geometry, not a Meta figure. Displayed on-profile circle diameter is disputed across secondary sources with no resolution.

text_overlay_20_percent_rule.status: retired by Meta (no longer a delivery gate)
text_overlay_20_percent_rule.note: The historical rule capped on-image ad text at 20% coverage, enforced via a 25-cell grid tool. Meta officially dropped the hard gate; current Meta docs (fetched ads-guide pages) only specify ad-copy character limits (125 primary text / 40 headline), not an image text-density rule. Secondary commentary still recommends keeping overlay text minimal for delivery/cost reasons.
